name: foxhand
description: Let Claude drive the Firefox you already use: your profile, open tabs and logins. Needs the Foxhand add-on and its helper.

token.title: Foxhand token
token.description: The token from the Foxhand add-on in Firefox: toolbar icon, Settings, copy the token.

mcp_url.title: Helper address
mcp_url.description: Where the Foxhand helper listens. Change it only if you changed the port in the add-on.
